lead.t:
CRYSTAL-INDUCED ARTHRITIS
Crystal deposition in and around joints can result in acute and
chronic inflammatory arthritis.
Gout
Gout is caused by the deposition of monosodium urate monohy drate (MSUM) crystals at synovial joints.
